name: bench
//: The informational performance suite: never a gate, so the gate tiers reach only its format, lint (which compiles the benches) and lint-sh (which shellchecks the harness scripts). The bench* targets are what `just bench*` and the Performance workflow run. bench-cli and bench-instructions build the mock fixture themselves as a tool, so a fixture change does not select this project.

bench.//: The forwarded arguments are Criterion's: `just bench <baseline> [options]` passes `--save-baseline <baseline>` and the options.

options.command: mkdir -p target/bench && cargo bench --locked --quiet -p llmlint-bench --bench engine_allocs | tee target/bench/allocs.md

bench-allocs.//: Also written to target/bench/allocs.md, which the Performance workflow's report embeds (Nx's own run banners stay out of it).
